verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this subject is a page titled 'Open source and standards' (fastmail-docs-23), with no content showing which code is published or under what license. JMAP being an open standard (fastmail-docs-21) covers protocol openness, not the product's own source, so this barely counts. Missing for 10: evidence that Fastmail's own product source (server, web client, or apps) is publicly readable, the specific open license it uses, any repository links, and independent corroboration.
